said.speaker: Ben
said.text: Okay, I'd like to do a fish, side view, big and simple. One continuous outline: start at the tail tip, run along the top of the body to the nose, round it, and come back along the belly to the tail. A judge reads a closed outline far better than fins and scales. Let's keep the body around x 18 to 42, y 12 to 28. Thoughts?

said.speaker: Chloe
said.text: Ben's outline is better than mine, so let's do that. I'll take the start at the tail tip and run the top edge out to the nose. Ava, could you take the belly back toward the tail? Dev, keep an eye on the nose round and the join where it closes at the tail.

said.speaker: Ben
said.text: Works for me, Chloe. One thing: the start is out at (4.5, 10.5), and the fish tail is around x 18. If the chain starts out there it has to run across empty table before it reaches the body. Could we move the start to the tail tip? Ava's already out that way, so maybe she can check the line from the start to the tail. I'll take the tail join so it closes cleanly with the belly.

said.speaker: Chloe
said.text: Ben, the start's already at the tail tip, right where my top arc begins at about (23.5, 20). I don't see anything at (4.5, 10.5) in the picture now. Ava, if you've got a stray chain out there, can you take it up so the belly can start from the tail? And yes, Ben, take the tail join.

said.speaker: Dev
said.text: Checked the picture: nothing at (4.5, 10.5), and the start's at about (23.5, 19.5), so the gap's gone. Two things. It's facing up, so it won't knock anything along the top edge. It needs to face right (0°) for the top arc. And the tail's around x 18, about 5 units left of the start, so Ben's tail join has to run leftward from the start. I'll hold my hands until Ava answers.

said.speaker: Ben
said.text: Dev's right, and the start's in the wrong place for the outline. I'm laying the tail run now, from the tail tip at x 18 right to about x 23, facing along the body. It stops short of the start so I don't crowd Chloe's hands. Chloe, once you agree, I'd move the start to the tail tip and have it face right. Then your top arc picks up from the tail, and the tail run feeds straight into it.

said.speaker: Chloe
said.text: Agreed, Ben. The start moves to the tail tip, facing right, so the fall runs tail, then top edge, then nose. Could you set that start domino at the tail tip? My arc start at (23.5, 20) faces up, so it can't take a fall from your run yet. Once your run reaches about x 23, I'll join my arc to it with a gentle connect so the curve doesn't kink.

said.speaker: Ben
said.text: Setting the start at the tail tip now, (18,20), facing right. Chloe, your arc's first domino at 23.5 still faces up, so it'll need turning right before your connect. Want me to take it down, or will you re-face it?

said.speaker: Ben
said.text: Start's at the tail tip now, facing right. I'm carrying the tail run on to about x 22.3 and stopping there so I don't crowd your domino at 23.5. Chloe, that one still faces up, so it won't take the fall. Could you re-face it to right before you connect?

said.speaker: Dev
said.text: Chloe, re-facing your arc start to 0 is quicker than taking it down. It's already at the end of Ben's run. Ben, once it faces right, a short connect from your last domino should close the gap, since 22.3 to 23.5 is more than 0.9 for a straight knock.

said.speaker: Chloe
said.text: Dev's right, clearing it is quicker than re-facing. I'm taking out the last up-facing piece near (23.5, 19.5) now, so Ben's run at 22.3 stays clear. Then I'll rebuild the arc from about 200° and connect it into your end, Ben.

said.speaker: Dev
said.text: Ava, where does your belly end near the tail? I'll hold the nose round until I know where to start it.

said.speaker: Chloe
said.text: Clearing's done, so I'm building the top arc from 200° now. Ben, your run ends around 22.3, so I'll join it with a connect once my first domino is standing.

said.speaker: Dev
said.text: Ava, your belly run looks like it faces right, so the fall would carry toward the nose instead of back to the tail. Could you check its direction, and tell me where the belly ends? I'll start the nose round once I know.

said.speaker: Ava
said.text: Dev, the belly's built facing left, from the nose at about (40.5, 25.5) back toward x 20. It'll end around (20, 25), about five units under the tail. Ben's tail join closes that gap. Nothing stray out at (4.5, 10.5) on my side. I'm looking over the belly now to confirm the ticks point left.

said.speaker: Ben
said.text: Correction for everyone: my tail run ended at about x 21.5, y 20, facing right, not 22.3 as I said. Chloe, once your first arc domino faces right, I'll connect my last one into it. The gap from 21.5 to your 23.5 is too wide for a straight knock. Ava, I'll close the tail join once you've confirmed the belly ticks point left.

said.speaker: Ava
said.text: Belly's facing left, nose at about (40.5, 25.5), and it's running back toward x 20. It should end around (20, 25), about five units under Ben's tail. Dev, you can start the nose round. Ben, once my last belly domino is down, the tail join closes the gap to the start at (18, 20).

said.speaker: Ben
said.text: Belly's confirmed, ending around (20,25). I'm closing the tail join from there up into the start at (18,20) now. Chloe, I'll link my tail run to your arc once your first domino faces right.

said.speaker: Chloe
said.text: Ben, got your correction: your tail run ends at about 21.5, 20. My arc's first domino is at about 23.4, 17.6. It faces up-right because it's on the curve, so don't re-face it. Make the connect from your end into it now. Hold the tail join until that's done, and I'll shout when my arc is standing.

said.speaker: Ben
said.text: Ben: My tail join didn't take. The picture only shows the belly from about x 31 to 40, not down to x 20, so there's nothing at (20,25) to connect from. Ava, can you carry the belly on from your end at 31.5, facing left, down to about x 20? Once it's standing there I'll connect the tail up into the start. I'm holding my hands until then.

said.speaker: Ava
said.text: Yep, I've got it, Ben. I'm carrying the belly on from 31.5 down to about x 20, still facing left. I'll call it when the last domino's down so you can connect the tail up into the start.

said.speaker: Ben
said.text: Chloe, I'm making the connect from my tail end at 21.5, 20 into your arc at 23.4, 17.6 now. Ava, I'll wait for the belly to reach about x 20 before the tail join.

said.speaker: Ava
said.text: Still on it, Ben. Belly's at about 31.5 and I'm carrying it on to x 20. I'll call it when the last domino is down.

said.speaker: Chloe
said.text: Ben, the connect from 21.5 into my arc at 23.4 is good. I'm carrying the top arc on from 200° toward 300° now, 15 to go. Ava, Ben can only see the belly from about x 31 to 40 in the picture. Could you check that it reaches x 20 before he closes the tail?

said.speaker: Ava
said.text: Belly's at about 31.5 and still going, so it doesn't reach x 20 yet. I'll call it out when the last domino is down, and Ben can make the tail join then.

said.speaker: Ben
said.text: Tail run and the connect into Chloe's arc are standing, so that join is done. I'm holding until Ava calls the belly at x 20. Then I'll run the tail join from (20,25) up into the start at (18,20). Dev, the nose round is yours once Ava confirms the belly end.

said.speaker: Chloe
said.text: Arc's standing from 200° and I'm carrying it on toward 300°, fifteen to go. Ava, when your last belly domino is down near x 20, call it out so Ben can close the tail join. Dev, the nose round is yours after that.

said.speaker: Ava
said.text: Belly's standing down to about x 28, still going left with about 11 to go. I'll call it when the last domino is at x 20, Ben.

said.speaker: Dev
said.text: Nose arc's standing, all 17. I'm joining its bottom end into the belly's nose at (40.3,25.5) now. The top edge waits until Chloe's arc reaches (38.5,18).

said.speaker: Chloe
said.text: Dev, my arc has two dominoes to go, and it ends around (33.5,13.9) at 300°, so it won't reach (38.5,18) on this radius. Once these two are standing, I'll extend from that end toward (38.5,18) with about ten more. Could you tell me the exact first domino of your top edge so I can aim the last one at it?

said.speaker: Ben
said.text: Chloe, that's the right plan: finish the two, then extend toward (38.5,18). Dev, can you point at the exact first domino of your top edge? Chloe, shout when your arc gets there and I'll check the join. Ava, call it when the belly's at x 20.

said.speaker: Chloe
said.text: Hands are free, so I'm finishing the last two arc dominoes at 300° and then running the top edge toward (38.5, 18). Dev, once you point at your first top-edge domino I'll aim the last one at it.

said.speaker: Dev
said.text: Chloe, Ben: the first domino of my top edge is at (38.5, 18), facing right, curving clockwise down the side of the nose. Chloe, aim your last one from the upper left so it lands within about 0.9 behind it, on the fall line. I'm holding the top until your arc is standing.

said.speaker: Ben
said.text: Dev, got it: top edge starts at (38.5,18), facing right. Chloe, aim your last arc domino at that from the upper left. My inspection says the join at (23,20) turns too sharply, so the arc isn't carrying from the start. That's my connect, so I'm fixing it now. Ava, I'm still holding the tail join until you call x 20.

said.speaker: Ava
said.text: Belly's standing all the way to x 20.5, last domino at (20.5, 25) facing left. Ben, go ahead and join the tail from there up into the start at (18, 20). I'm checking the belly for gaps and the kink near the nose now.

said.speaker: Ben
said.text: Ava, belly's confirmed at (20.5, 25). Joining it up into the start now. Once that's standing I'll go back to the kink at (23, 20).

said.speaker: Dev
said.text: Nose join at (40, 25): my inspection shows the next domino sitting off to the side, so the belly and nose aren't carrying through yet. I'm fixing it now. Chloe, the top edge still starts at (38.5, 18) whenever your arc reaches it.

said.speaker: Chloe
said.text: Dev, Ben: my arc finishes at 300° around (33.5,14), then I'm extending toward (38.5,18) with about ten more. My last domino should land near (37.6,17.4), facing right, about 0.7 behind your first top-edge domino. I'll shout when it's standing so you can check the join.

said.speaker: Ava
said.text: Belly's clear from the nose to (20.5, 25) with no gaps that I can see. Ben, go ahead and join the tail up into the start. Dev, the nose kink is yours, so I'm leaving it alone. I'll stay off the table until someone needs a hand.

said.speaker: Dev
said.text: Dev: nose fix at (40,25.5) is in, and the inspection shows the belly and nose carrying through. Ben, the tail join from (20.5,25) is yours. Chloe, I'm still holding the top edge at (38.5,18) until your last arc domino at (37.6,17.4) is standing. Ava, thanks for the belly check.

said.speaker: Ben
said.text: Got it, Dev. The tail join from (20.5,25) up into the start is mine. Thanks, Ava, for the belly check. Chloe, I'm not touching your arc's first domino.

said.speaker: Chloe
said.text: Dev, Ben: my arc's last domino is going in now, aimed at the first top-edge domino at (38.5, 18). I'll call it when it's standing so you can check the join.

said.speaker: Facilitator
said.text: 10 minutes left! When time's up I'll push your start domino; only what's connected to it will fall.

said.speaker: Dev
said.text: Ben, agreed on the kink at (23,20). Chloe, once your last domino at (37.6,17.4) is standing, I'll check the join into (38.5,18) before the top edge goes down.

said.speaker: Chloe
said.text: Dev, Ben: still placing that last domino at (37.6,17.4), aimed at your first top-edge domino. I'll call it the moment it's standing so you can check the join.

said.speaker: Ava
said.text: Ben, I'm staying off your join until the tail's standing. Then I'll inspect from the start and call out any breaks. The two loose dominoes near (19, 19) look like they're on your side, so can you check them when you run the tail?

said.speaker: Dev
said.text: Chloe, I'm holding until your last domino is standing. Going by the picture, (37.6,17.4) to my first domino at (38.5,18) is about 1.1 apart, which is over the 0.9 reach. If you can, nudge it in to around (37.9,17.7) so it's roughly 0.7 from my start, on the fall line. I'll check the join as soon as you call it standing.

said.speaker: Ava
said.text: Ben, got it. I'm not touching the tail or the loose pair near (19,19). I'm just taking a look from the start so we know what's still broken. Shout when the tail's standing.

said.speaker: Chloe
said.text: Dev, good catch. I'm moving my last domino to around (37.9,17.7), about 0.7 behind your first top-edge domino on the fall line. I'll call it the moment it's standing so you can check the join.

said.speaker: Ava
said.text: Ben, from the start my inspection shows the tail isn't joined yet. The start only carries about 18 dominoes, and the two loose ones near (19.5,19) are still sitting off to the side. Tell me when the tail's standing and I'll check it again.

said.speaker: Ben
said.text: Ava, yes, I'll check the two loose ones near (19,19) once the tail is standing. Still eight to place on the join.

said.speaker: Ava
said.text: Ben, sounds good. Still eight on the join? If you want, I can take the last few of the tail while you do the loose pair near (19,19). Otherwise I'll keep off and wait for you to call the re-check.

said.speaker: Ben
said.text: Ava, two dominoes left on the tail. I'll shout when it's standing, then I'll check the loose pair at (19,19) and fix the kink at (23,20).

said.speaker: Ben
said.text: Ava, I'm placing the last two tail dominoes now from (20.5,25) up into the start. I'll call it once they're standing, then check the loose pair at (19,19).

said.speaker: Ava
said.text: Got it, Ben. I'm staying off the tail. Shout when it's standing and I'll inspect from the start.

said.speaker: Dev
said.text: Inspection's in. From the start we reach about 18 dominoes, and the body is cut off at the tail. That matches Ben's join from (20.5,25) into the start, which isn't standing yet, so that's the one to close first. Chloe, the arc still has the gap near (32.5-33.5,14). I'm holding the top edge until your last domino at (37.9,17.7) is standing.

said.speaker: Chloe
said.text: Dev, Ben: I've got the gap in my arc near (33,14) open, so I'm closing it now. After that the last domino goes in at (37.9,17.7), and I'll call it as soon as it's standing.

said.speaker: Dev
said.text: Thanks, Chloe. I'll check the join when you call it.

said.speaker: Ben
said.text: Got it, Dev. The tail join from (20.5,25) up into the start is still going. I'll shout when it's standing so Ava can recheck, then I'll check the loose pair near (19,19).

said.speaker: Ava
said.text: Ben, I'm still off the tail. Shout when it's standing and I'll inspect from the start.

said.speaker: Chloe
said.text: Got it, Dev. Closing the gap at (33,14) first, then the last domino at (37.9,17.7). I'll call it the moment it's standing.

said.speaker: Dev
said.text: Sounds good, Ben. I'll wait for Chloe to call her last domino before I touch the top edge.

said.speaker: Ben
said.text: Still placing the last few tail dominoes from (20.5,25) up into the start. I'll shout as soon as they're standing so Ava can check from the start.

said.speaker: Ben
said.text: Hands are free, so I'm checking the tail from (20.5,25) up into the start before I call it. Ava, I'll shout as soon as it's confirmed standing, and I'll hold the loose pair and the kink until then.

said.speaker: Ben
said.text: Tail's broken at (17.5,22.5): that line ends facing up-left with nothing ahead. I'm connecting it into the start from behind now. Ava, I'll call it once it's standing.

said.speaker: Facilitator
said.text: 5 minutes left! When time's up I'll push your start domino; only what's connected to it will fall.

said.speaker: Ava
said.text: Ben, got it. Still keeping off the tail. Shout when the connection at (17.5,22.5) is standing and I'll inspect from the start right away.

said.speaker: Dev
said.text: Chloe, five minutes left. Is the last domino at (37.9,17.7) standing yet? If it's not, tell me and I'll build the top edge last, after the rest is settled.

said.speaker: Chloe
said.text: Five minutes. I'm still closing the gap at (33,14), then the last domino goes in at (37.9,17.7). Ben, the tail join from the start is the priority. I'll call each piece as it stands.

said.speaker: Chloe
said.text: Dev, not standing yet. I'm still closing the arc gap at (33,14). Then the last domino goes in at (37.9,17.7), about 0.7 behind your first top-edge domino. I'll call it the moment it's up so you can check the join.

said.speaker: Ava
said.text: Five minutes. Ben's on the tail, Chloe's on the arc gap, and Dev's holding the top edge until that last domino stands. I'm off hands, so I'm taking a full look at the table now and I'll call out any breaks I see.

said.speaker: Dev
said.text: Chloe, the top edge is about two minutes of work and it waits on that last domino. If the arc gap at (33,14) is going to take more than a minute, put the (37.9,17.7) domino down first and call it.

said.speaker: Ava
said.text: Inspection's in. Breaks: the loose pair at (19,19) and the tail near (17,21) are Ben's, and I'm staying off them. Nobody's on the kink at (24,16) on the top arc, so I'm closing it now. Shout if you're already on it.

said.speaker: Chloe
said.text: Dev, the arc gap is going to take more than a minute, so I'm putting the (37.9,17.7) domino down now. I'll call it the moment it's standing, then I'm back on the gap at (33,14). Thanks, Ava, the kink's yours.

said.speaker: Dev
said.text: Chloe, I'm holding for your call on the (37.9,17.7) domino. If the top edge hasn't started by about two minutes left, I'll drop it rather than rush.

said.speaker: Chloe
said.text: Dev, the last domino at (37.9,17.7) is standing and facing down-right toward your first top-edge domino at (38.5,18). Check the join when you're ready. I'm back on the arc gap at (33,14) now.

said.speaker: Ben
said.text: Ava, the tail connection is placed: seven dominoes from (17.5,22) up to the start at (18,20), ending facing right. One spot near (17,20) wouldn't take a domino, so I'm checking that join now before you inspect from the start.

said.speaker: Ben
said.text: Ava, hold off inspecting from the start. The join at (17,20) isn't standing yet: there's a skipped spot and the turn is too sharp. I'm closing it now, then I'll check the loose pair at (19,19). I'll shout once the whole tail is standing.

said.speaker: Ava
said.text: Ben, I'm staying off your tail. I'm closing the kink at (24,16) on the top arc now. Shout when the join at (17,20) is standing and I'll inspect from the start.

said.speaker: Ben
said.text: Still on the fix at (17,20), only two in so far. I'll shout the moment the tail is standing, and then I'll check the loose pair at (19,19).

said.speaker: Ava
said.text: Still on the kink at (24,16). Ben, I'm not touching your tail.

said.speaker: Chloe
said.text: Dev, I'm still on the arc gap at (33,14). I'll call it the moment it's standing. If you need to drop the top edge to make time, go ahead.

said.speaker: Dev
said.text: Dev here. The top edge is standing: seven dominoes from about (38.5,18.5) down to (40.5,21), facing down-right. Chloe, thanks, the join into (38.5,18) looks in range. I'm off hands now, so I'm inspecting the whole table. I'll call out any breaks I see that nobody's already on.

said.speaker: Chloe
said.text: Dev, thanks for the top edge. I'm closing the arc gap at (33,14) now and I'll call it the moment it's standing. Anyone who sees a break outside Ben's tail and Ava's kink, shout and I'll take it if I'm free.

said.speaker: Facilitator
said.text: 2 minutes left! When time's up I'll push your start domino; only what's connected to it will fall.

said.speaker: Ben
said.text: Ava, hold off inspecting from the start. The join at (17,20) isn't standing yet: it's the skipped spot plus the sharp turn, and only four are in. I'll shout the moment it's up. If we run out of time, the tail won't carry and the push only drops the start-to-arc run.

said.speaker: Ava
said.text: Ben, holding off the start inspection until you call the join at (17,20). I'm still on the kink at (24,16), so I'm not touching your tail or the loose pair.

said.speaker: Chloe
said.text: Chloe here. The inspection confirms the arc gap at (33,14): six dominoes from (32.5,14) to (35.5,15) aren't connected. I'm closing it now. Ben, I'm not touching your tail.

said.speaker: Ben
said.text: Calling the tail: the fix at (17,20) won't finish in 90 seconds, so I'm stopping. The start, the arc, Dev's top edge, the nose and Ava's belly are already chained together, so the push should still carry the outline. Ava, you can inspect from the start once Chloe's gap at (33,14) is standing and Ava's kink is closed.

said.speaker: Chloe
said.text: Ben, understood, the tail's out. I'm on the (33,14) arc gap now and I'll call it the moment it's standing.

said.speaker: Dev
said.text: Dev again: closing the gap at (40.5,21) on my top edge with a fix now. Staying off Ben's tail, Ava's kink and Chloe's arc.

said.speaker: Chloe
said.text: Chloe here: my hands are free, so I'm closing the arc gap at (33,14) with a fix now. Dev, I'm leaving your (40.5,21) fix alone. I'll call it the moment it's standing.

said.speaker: Ava
said.text: Still on the kink at (24,16), nearly through. Not touching Ben's tail or Chloe's gap. I'll call it the moment it's standing, then I'll inspect from the start.

said.speaker: Ben
said.text: Ben here: tail's out, and I'm not touching anything. Chloe, Ava, shout when the (33,14) gap and the (24,16) kink are standing, then we hold for the push.
